QuestInfo.name: Lilin's Invitation
QuestInfo.0: #p1101002# needs your help preparing for the continental conference.
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# wants you to see his sister in #m140000000#. She says she found one of the 5 heroes who defeated the Black Mage, and #p1101002# wants the hero to attend the continental conference.

0.0: A continental conference isn't much good if we're the only ones who attend. We have to invite the leaders of other groups, and anyone else who could garner respect for our cause.
0.1: Have you ever heard of the heroes who defeated the Black Mages centuries ago?
0.2: Apparently one of those heroes was found frozen in the ice of my hometown, #m140000000#. My sister nursed this hero back to full health, miraculously enough.
0.3: We must have this hero at our continental conference. Though one person isn't enough to turn the tides of war against the Black Mage, the gesture would mean a lot to the other attendees.
0.4: A boat in #b#m104000000##k can take you to #m140000000#. I'll send you right away just this time.\r\n\r\n(You will be moved to Ereve after you accept.)

no.0: Frankly, I don't care much for heroes, either. But as a Cygnus Knight, you must put aside your feelings and do as you're ordered.

1.0: Hello there! If you're here to watch the penguins, I'm afraid they're all very busy with work right now. Or is there something else I can help you with...?
1.1: A continental conference? Gee, that sounds important. Okay, I'll get this letter to Aran.\r\n\r\n(You will be moved to Ereve after you accept.)

npc.0: The boat in #m104000000# can take you to #m140000000#. Hurry along, now.

item.0: What brings you to #m140000000#? There really isn't much to see here.
